title: Three banks, one page
subtitle: What one family holds, added up
note: The family is Antevo’s example household. Its three banks are made up. Companies are described, not named. Every figure is the Antevo Wealth tool’s answer on the date shown.

tries.label: The page, line by line
tries.source: Antevo Wealth, 25 Nov 2026. Amounts in francs at that day’s prices.

items.do: Record every account, not only the large ones
items.why: A pension pot, a broker app or a cash account left out makes the total wrong.

items.do: Add each holding up across banks before judging any one statement
items.why: Five holdings sit in all three portfolios of the first bank.
Three funds at two banks hold CHF 6.0m, and each is one line here.

items.do: Ask what a bad year would cost the whole
items.why: One portfolio’s answer is not the family’s answer.

items.do: Write down who in the family holds the whole picture
items.why: Each bank knows its own slice.

sections.title: Accounts and banks
sections.so_what: The page is only as complete as what has been recorded. An account that is not in Antevo Wealth is not on it.
evidence: Each holding names the account that holds it
Each account names its bank and its country

sections.title: The same holdings in several portfolios
sections.so_what: No single portfolio statement shows the real share of any of them.
evidence: Five holdings sit in all three portfolios at the first bank
Each in a different weight

sections.title: The funds
sections.so_what: A fund can hold the same companies you already own directly. That is the next question.
evidence: A world fund and a Swiss fund at the second bank: CHF 3.91m
A Nasdaq fund at the third bank: CHF 2.09m

sections.title: What is not here
sections.so_what: What a family owns includes both. Record them, and the same question covers them.
evidence: No property recorded
No loans recorded

links.text: The first bank holds single shares; the other two hold funds. The funds can hold the very companies the first bank holds directly.
Every statement is accurate. The share of one company in everything appears only when the three are added up.

watch: A new account opened anywhere: record it the same week
The largest company’s share of everything, once the funds are opened
Any holding that appears at a second bank
disclaimer: From the Antevo Wealth tool’s answers on the date shown. The banks are made up. The page describes what is held and where; it is not investment advice and says nothing about what to buy or sell.
